title: HTTP Workflows: Handle Requests and Call Web APIs | Orchard Core
description:
Services outside a site, such as a payment provider or a stock system, need a way to start a workflow, and a workflow needs a way to call them and to answer the caller.

The HTTP Workflows Activities feature gives a workflow a URL that starts it, activities that reply to the caller or redirect it, an HTTP Request task that calls a web API and branches on the status code, and a Signal event that waits for a link.

In this video:
• The HTTP activities and where to find them in the designer
• Receive a request: the URL, the antiforgery token and the token life span
• Read and answer the request in a script
• Call a web API and handle its status codes
• Run the workflow and read the response
• Wait for a signal with a link
• Filters, redirects and moving a workflow to another site
